column14: [RULED 2026-09-03] The bottom of the ruled tap-rate band: a player who never taps. The sim models 'no tapping' by leaving combat.tap unset, not by setting a rate of 0.
[RULED 2026-09-03, record S2] the top of the ruled band -- as fast as a player can physically tap. Tapping is free and unlimited, so this is the only cap on tap throughput.
[RULED 2026-09-03] The average tap rate all balance math is sized at (4/s).
[RULED 2026-09-03] 1 = TRUE: tap damage is NOT reduced by boss defense, so the same tap is worth ~2.5x more against a 60%-mitigation deep boss. A rule rather than a tuning value.
[RULED 2026-09-03, record S2] 1 = TRUE, and the record marks it 'for now': no energy cost, no cooldown, no per-fight cap. Any future limit must still satisfy the design definition in A1.
[OPEN -- COSMETIC] Which pond creature the Tapper IS. Deliberately blank: the tap has a diegetic body, but the species and art are a later cosmetic pick. No sim reads this.
[OPEN] The player-facing form of tap progression BEYOND feeding the Tapper. Blank on purpose; the ladder in A:D is the whole mechanic today.
heading. THE VARIABILITY HALF OF THE RULED +5%: the 5% is an EXPECTED value over a distribution, delivered by a short-lived, player-visible TAP SURGE. The four knobs below are the whole design.
[RULED-PLAYTEST-START 2026-09-04] The probability that a surge is available for a given EXPEDITION ATTEMPT. This knob is the feel almost on its own.
[RULED-PLAYTEST-START 2026-09-04] How much stronger a surged tap is: a multiplier on col B's percentage, so a surge scales with the Tapper's level and the pond and never becomes a flat number.
[RULED-PLAYTEST-START 2026-09-04] How many expedition ATTEMPTS one granted surge covers -- the whole attempt, win or lose. Measured in attempts and not in seconds on purpose.
[RULED-PLAYTEST-START 2026-09-04] How many UNSPENT surges a player may bank. 1 = no stockpiling, so a player who gets one is nudged to spend it now.
[RULED SHAPE 2026-09-04, PRESENTATION OPEN] The balance math assumes a surge is PLAYER-VISIBLE BEFORE THE ATTEMPT STARTS: granted between fights, shown in the tray, consumed by the next attempt.
[RULED 2026-09-04] The tap's EXPECTED contribution to pond power, as a fraction. A TARGET cell, not a tune: col B's scale and the two surge knobs above are solved against it.
